claims.statement: The Foo Valley Municipal Utility said a water main burst in Eastfield on 20 November 2024 and that it issued a boil notice for 3,400 customers until 23 November 2024.
claims.notes: The Inquirer reports independently on the event; it gives no figure.

sources.title: Service notice: main burst, Eastfield
sources.supporting_excerpt: A water main burst in Eastfield on 20 November 2024, and the utility issued a boil notice for 3,400 customers until 23 November 2024.

sources.title: Brown water in Eastfield
sources.supporting_excerpt: Eastfield residents told the Lower Basin Inquirer that the tap water ran brown on 20 November 2024, and reporters saw crews digging at the junction of Mill Road.

claims.verification_note: Utility and the Inquirer's own reporting are independent origins; the Inquirer gives no figure. The customer count is the utility's only.

claims.statement: The Regional Water Authority reported that sampling on 10 February 2025 found solvent discharged from the Millbrook outfall exceeded the permitted limit by a factor of two, and that it issued a compliance order to Ridgeline Chemical.

sources.title: Compliance bulletin, February 2025
sources.supporting_excerpt: Sampling on 10 February 2025 found that solvent discharged from the Millbrook outfall exceeded the permitted limit by a factor of two, and the Authority issued a compliance order to Ridgeline Chemical.

sources.title: Authority orders plant to cut discharge
sources.supporting_excerpt: The Valley Courier reported that, according to the Authority, solvent discharged from the Millbrook outfall exceeded the permitted limit in February 2025.

claims.verification_note: The Courier relays the Authority: one origin.
